description.content:
The Confluent Schema Registry provides a RESTful interface for storing and retrieving Avro, JSON Schema, and Protobuf schemas. It stores a versioned history of all schemas based on a specified subject name strategy, provides multiple compatibility settings, and allows evolution of schemas according to configured compatibility settings.
